hotel-sale-data-room-document-index-2026.title: 酒店准备出售，先整理哪一份买方能复核的数据室？
hotel-sale-data-room-document-index-2026.titleEn: Preparing to Sell a Hotel: Which Data Room Should the Seller Organise First?
hotel-sale-data-room-document-index-2026.description: 酒店出售资料准备应先建立可追到原件的卖方资料目录与缺件台账，明确主体、期间、版本、披露权限、补件责任和问题结案证据。
hotel-sale-data-room-document-index-2026.descriptionEn: Prepare a traceable hotel sale data room with a document index covering entities, periods, versions, disclosure permissions and unresolved questions.
hotel-sale-data-room-document-index-2026.author: 迈创兄弟C&T（MarvelBros C&T）
content: 酒店准备出售，先建立一份能追到原件的卖方资料目录与缺件台账，再按主体、期间、版本和披露权限组织资料库。酒店出售资料准备的起点，是让买方能够核对每项重要说法的依据，并知道还有哪些问题没有解决。
这里的数据室，可以理解为供获授权人员查阅的交易资料库及其索引。它可以使用专门系统，也可以从权限清楚的文件夹和一张目录表开始。关键不在软件，而在买方能否从目录找到对应文件，确认文件讲的是哪家公司、哪项权利、哪个期间，以及后来有没有变化。
销售介绍可以说明酒店位置、产品和经营亮点，却不能替代这套复核关系。如果收入表、合同和物业资料分别来自不同主体，即使每份文件都是真的，放在一起也未必能够回答买方的问题。
## 先把公开线索变成应核文件
北京市公共资源交易服务平台2026年9月8日披露的山水酒店股份及相关债权转让项目，列有财务报表、审计报告、评估报告等备查资料，并提示借款、抵押及评估特别事项。页面还注明部分财务数据采用合并口径。来源为该平台挂牌披露信息，项目编号S110000D013105504002。
这些信息适合用来说明资料之间为什么需要对应关系。看到披露，不等于已经读到备查全文；读到财务数字，也不等于知道其中哪些属于拟购买的单项资产。本文未取得该项目备查文件全文，不据此判断其合同风险、资料是否缺失或交易成败。
对于准备出售酒店的业主，可以从这类公开线索反推自己的准备动作：介绍中提到的权利，应由什么文件支持；报表覆盖的主体，是否与拟出售范围一致；重要事项发生变化后，谁更新目录、谁通知已经获授权的查阅者。
## 酒店出售资料准备，先统一目录口径
由业主指定一名卖方资料统筹人，先写清拟出售的对象和范围。出售物业、公司股权或经营相关权利，所需资料并不完全相同；尚未明确的范围，应保留为待确认事项，不能靠文件夹名称替代交易判断。
接着按买方需要核对的问题组织目录。物业权属与负担、租赁和品牌管理安排、财务与经营数据、许可及用途资料、设备状况与维修事项、员工和预收款等相关义务，可以作为起始分类。它们是整理提示，并非适用于所有交易的统一法定清单。实际范围应由参与项目的专业人员根据标的确定。
每条记录至少应能回答几件事：资料对应哪个主体或权利，覆盖什么期间，采用什么口径，当前是什么版本，原件由谁持有，获授权的人从哪里查到。再把获取和核验状态、披露权限、买方问题、补件责任、下一动作日期及结案证据放在同一行。
例如，同一酒店名称下可能有物业持有人、经营公司和品牌管理方。目录若只写“酒店合同”，接手的人仍要重新问一遍。改为具体合同名称、签约主体、有效版本及补充文件位置，才能让后续复核沿着同一条线进行。
期间也需要分开。年度审计数据与本年阶段性经营数据不能只按文件生成时间排序。数据截至日、编制或签署日期、上传日期分别保留，才能看清文件的新旧及适用范围。新文件替代旧文件时，应标明替代关系，保留必要历史版本，避免旧链接仍被当成当前依据。
## 一条抵押资料记录怎样填写
仍以上述挂牌页面作公开线索示范。页面披露了特定房产的抵押安排，并说明有关合同备查。卖方目录可以把这条线索登记为“相关房产抵押文件”，写明对应主体及资产标识，注明公开信息来源，再指向获授权查阅的合同及其相关文件。
在尚未取得合同全文时，核验状态应写“已读公开披露，备查全文未取得”。待核问题可以是：合同覆盖哪些资产，当前状态由什么资料说明，是否存在后续变更。不能因为网页没有展示这些内容，就写成“卖方缺件”，更不能直接填上“抵押已解除”。
这条示范记录只展示从公开线索走向原件的办法。具体合同如何影响交易，需要结合原文和项目情况判断；本文不替代该项判断。
## 把缺件与疑问分开管理
资料工作容易停在“已经上传”。但上传之后，可能仍有主体不一致、期间不匹配、附件不完整或说法互相矛盾的问题。
建议把几种状态区分开：文件由谁持有但尚未取得；文件已经取得但尚未核对；核对后发现需要解释的差异；问题已有依据支持的处理结果。未公开、未取得和实际不存在，是不同情况，不应合并成一个“缺失”。
每项未结问题都要有可执行的下一步。需要财务提供报表口径说明，就由财务负责人落实；需要查清合同附件，就由该资料的持有人和项目法务衔接。统筹人负责追踪跨部门事项，不代替专业人员给出结论。
结案也不能只写“已回复”。应说明收到哪份文件或解释、由谁核对、哪一处疑问得到回答，还有哪些限制仍然保留。若专业意见尚未形成，台账可以记录进展，但不能提前把问题标为解决。
## 更新日期比“最新文件”四个字更可靠
中青旅2026年10月13日的进展公告披露，截至10月10日尚未征集到符合条件的意向受让方，后续挂牌价格调整事项仍需股东会审议。这里应同时保留公告日期和事实截至日，不把历史公告直接写成今天的交易状态。来源为《中国证券报》刊载的中青旅公告，编号临2026-033。
对卖方资料库而言，同样需要明确更新触发条件。新的报表形成、合同发生变更、重要事项得到确认或交易安排调整，都可能使原有说明需要更新。统筹人应检查受影响的目录条目、相关说明和已开放文件，而不是只把新文件追加到最末尾。
已经向买方解释过的问题若发生变化，也应留下更新记录。这样做有助于双方知道哪些判断需要重新核对，但不保证交易推进或成交，更不能用未成交倒推资料准备存在问题。
## 开放前，沿一条资料链实际走一次
首次对外开放前，可以由获授权、未参与该条资料整理的复核人选取一项重要记录，尝试从目录定位原文，并核对主体、期间和版本。遇到打不开的链接、不明确的附件关系或无法解释的口径，就回到台账登记责任人和处理动作。
如果资料包含未获授权披露的商业信息或个人信息，应先暂停开放相关文件，由项目负责人和专业人员确认可提供范围及处理方式。开放权限、下载权限和后续变更通知应与项目安排一致，不能以“文件已收齐”为由一次性全部共享。
一条记录的走查只是最低成本试运行，不能证明整个数据室完整，更不等于买方尽职调查完成。正式开放前，还需按交易范围与风险扩展检查；关键资料和重大未结事项应单独确认。验收时关注的也不只是文件数量，而是资料能否定位、口径是否清楚、重要疑问是否有依据和责任人，以及权限是否符合安排。
小型单体酒店可以先用精简目录和受控文件夹；已经建立成熟数据室的项目，则优先检查新增文件、历史版本和未结问题。没有必要为了形式完整而重建一套重复系统。
卖方第一步可以很具体：指定资料统筹人，用配套的卖方资料目录与缺件台账，从一项重要说法开始，把它对应的原文、核验状态和下一动作记录清楚。把这条关系做通，再扩展到整个拟出售范围。
## 延伸阅读

如果还在评估资产退出前的经营基础，可以结合《酒店资产有了新的退出机会，业主先把三笔经营账算清楚》继续梳理经营底稿。本篇目录用于组织交易资料，两者解决的问题不同。

contentEn: When preparing to sell a hotel, first build a seller's document index and missing-document register that lead to the underlying records. Then organise the document repository by entity, reporting period, version and disclosure permission. The starting point is to let a buyer verify the basis of each important statement and identify unresolved questions.

A data room here means a transaction document repository and its index, accessible to authorised users. It may use a dedicated platform or begin with controlled folders and a spreadsheet. What matters is whether the buyer can locate the relevant document, identify the company, right and period it concerns, and establish whether anything has subsequently changed.

Sales materials can describe the hotel's location, product and trading strengths. They cannot replace those connections. If revenue reports, contracts and property records concern different entities, even individually authentic documents may not collectively answer the buyer's questions.
## Turn public disclosures into records to obtain and verify

A September 8, 2026 listing on the Beijing Public Resources Trading Service Platform for shares in Shanshui Hotel and related receivables identifies financial statements, audit and valuation reports available for inspection. It also flags borrowing, mortgages and special valuation matters, and notes that certain financial figures are consolidated. The source is the platform's listing disclosure, project S110000D013105504002.

These disclosures illustrate why documents need to be connected. Reading a disclosure does not mean reading the underlying inspection documents. Seeing financial figures does not establish which amounts belong to an individual asset being acquired. This article has not obtained the full inspection documents and draws no conclusion about contractual risk, missing records or the transaction's outcome.

An owner preparing a sale can work backwards from such disclosures: which document supports each stated right, whether the reporting entity matches the proposed sale scope, and who updates the index and informs authorised readers when an important matter changes.
## Hotel sale preparation starts with a consistent document index

The owner should appoint a seller-side document coordinator and first describe the proposed sale object and scope. A property sale, share sale and transfer of operating rights do not require identical records. Any unresolved scope should remain a question to confirm; folder names cannot settle the transaction structure.

Organise the index around what the buyer needs to verify. Initial categories might include property ownership and encumbrances, lease and brand-management arrangements, financial and operating data, permits and permitted-use records, equipment condition and maintenance matters, and relevant employee and advance-payment obligations. These are organisational prompts, not a universal statutory checklist. Project professionals should determine the actual scope.

Each entry should identify the entity or right concerned, period, reporting basis, current version, original document holder and location available to authorised readers. Keep acquisition and verification status, disclosure permission, buyer questions, the person responsible for obtaining further records, next-action date and closure evidence in the same row.

A single hotel name, for example, may cover a property owner, operating company and brand manager. An entry labelled merely “hotel contract” leaves the next reader asking the same questions again. A precise contract name, signing entities, effective version and location of supplementary documents allow subsequent review to follow the same trail.

Keep periods distinct too. Annual audited figures and current-year interim operating data should not be sorted only by file creation date. Retain the data cut-off, preparation or signature date and upload date separately. When one document supersedes another, identify that relationship and preserve necessary historical versions so an old link is not mistaken for current evidence.
## How to record one mortgage-related document request

Use the same listing as a public-disclosure illustration. It describes a mortgage arrangement over specified property and says the relevant contract is available for inspection. A seller's index could record “mortgage documents for the relevant property”, identify the entity and asset, cite the public disclosure and point to the contract and related documents available to authorised readers.

Until the full contract has been obtained, the status should read “public disclosure reviewed; full inspection document not obtained”. Questions to verify might include which assets the contract covers, what records establish its current status and whether subsequent amendments exist. Their absence from the webpage does not justify recording “seller document missing”, still less “mortgage released”.

This sample entry only illustrates the route from a public disclosure to an underlying record. Assessing how the contract affects a transaction requires its actual terms and project circumstances; this article does not perform that assessment.
## Manage missing records and open questions separately
Document preparation can stall at “uploaded”. Yet the uploaded material may still contain mismatched entities or periods, incomplete attachments or contradictory statements.

Distinguish records held by an identified person but not yet obtained, records obtained but not yet checked, differences requiring explanation after review, and questions resolved by supporting evidence. Not publicly disclosed, not obtained and genuinely nonexistent are different conditions and should not share a single “missing” label.

Every open question needs an executable next step. Finance should provide the required explanation of reporting scope; the document holder and project legal adviser should coordinate missing contractual attachments. The coordinator tracks matters across departments without substituting for professional conclusions.

Nor should closure mean merely “answered”. Record the document or explanation received, who checked it, which question it answers and which limitations remain. A register may show progress while a professional opinion is pending, but it should not mark the matter resolved prematurely.
## Specific dates are more reliable than “latest document”

CYTS's October 13, 2026 progress announcement reported that no eligible prospective transferee had been secured as of October 10 and that the proposed authorisation to adjust subsequent listing prices still required shareholder approval. Retain both the announcement date and the fact cut-off; a historical announcement should not be presented as today's transaction status. The source is CYTS announcement 2026-033, published in China Securities Journal.

A seller's repository likewise needs explicit update triggers. New financial statements, contract amendments, confirmation of material matters or changes to transaction arrangements may require earlier explanations to be updated. The coordinator should review affected index entries, explanations and accessible files rather than simply append a new file at the end.

If an issue already explained to a buyer changes, retain an update record. This helps both parties identify assessments requiring renewed review. It does not guarantee transaction progress or completion, and failure to complete cannot establish that document preparation was defective.
## Walk one document trail before opening access

Before first external access, an authorised reviewer who did not prepare the selected entry can take one important record, locate its underlying document through the index and check its entity, period and version. Broken links, unclear attachment relationships and unexplained reporting differences should return to the register with an assigned owner and action.

If a file includes commercial or personal information not authorised for disclosure, suspend access to that file while the project lead and relevant professionals confirm what can be supplied and how it should be handled. Access, download rights and subsequent change notifications should follow the project arrangements; collecting all files is no justification for unrestricted sharing.

Walking one trail is only a low-cost trial. It does not establish that the whole data room is complete or that buyer due diligence has been performed. Before formal access, extend the checks according to transaction scope and risk, and separately confirm key records and material open issues. Review should consider whether records can be located, reporting scope is clear, important questions have evidence and an accountable person, and permissions match the agreed arrangements, rather than merely count files.

A small independent hotel can start with a concise index and controlled folders. A project with an established data room should prioritise new records, historical versions and open questions. There is no need to build a duplicate system for appearance's sake.

The seller's first action can be specific: appoint a coordinator and use the accompanying seller's document index and missing-document register to trace one important statement to its source, verification status and next action. Make that connection work, then extend it across the proposed sale scope.
## Further reading

Owners still assessing the operating foundations for an asset exit can also read “New Exit Opportunities for Hotel Assets: Three Operating Ledgers Owners Should Reconcile First”. That article addresses operating records; this index organises transaction documents. They serve different purposes.
